question: What is the primary function of computer software?

options.A: To cool down the internal processors
options.B: To instruct the hardware on what to do
options.C: To connect the computer to the internet
options.D: To provide physical power to the machine

explanation: Software consists of instructions and programs that direct the physical hardware components to perform specific tasks. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T3#BMP123_U1_T3_h1)

question: Why is computer hardware useless without software?

options.A: Hardware is designed only for aesthetic value
options.B: Hardware cannot store any data permanently
options.C: Hardware needs software instructions to function
options.D: Hardware lacks the electrical wiring to turn on

explanation: Physical machine parts cannot perform any useful work or process information without the guidance of software programs. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T3#BMP123_U1_T3_h1)

question: Which of the following is a primary example of system software?
explanation: Operating systems like Windows or Linux manage core hardware and provide a platform for other programs, making them system software. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T3#BMP123_U1_T3_h2)

question: What is the main role of system software in a computer?

options.A: To help users type letters and create reports
options.B: To manage hardware resources and run other programs
options.C: To connect local network printers to the internet
options.D: To design graphical images for clinical presentations

explanation: System software handles internal computer operations, resource allocation, and provides a stable base for user applications. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T3#BMP123_U1_T3_h2)

question: What is the main purpose of application software?

options.A: To help users perform specific everyday tasks
options.B: To control the basic internal hardware parts
options.C: To translate computer languages into binary code
options.D: To protect the computer from external viruses

explanation: Applications are built to allow users to carry out practical activities like writing, calculating, or browsing the web. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T3#BMP123_U1_T3_h3)

question: A midwife wants to type an official memo for the maternity ward. Which type of software should she open?
explanation: Word processors and document creators are application software used directly for writing tasks like memos and reports. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T3#BMP123_U1_T3_h3)

question: Which computer component directly processes the instructions sent by software?
explanation: The CPU is the hardware chip responsible for executing instructions and processing data received from software programs. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T3#BMP123_U1_T3_h4)

question: How does system software help hardware and application software communicate?

options.A: It prevents the computer hardware from overheating during use
options.B: It supplies physical electricity to the internal motherboard
options.C: It permanently stores all typed documents on the monitor
options.D: It translates user commands into language the CPU understands

explanation: System software serves as an intermediary, taking requests from applications and translating them for the physical processor. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T3#BMP123_U1_T3_h4)

question: What defines open source software?

options.A: The software requires a paid license for every computer
options.B: The code is kept secret and locked by the creator
options.C: The source code is freely available for users to modify
options.D: The program can only run without an internet connection

explanation: Open source programs allow anyone to inspect, alter, and share the underlying source code freely. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T3#BMP123_U1_T3_h5)

question: Why might an organization choose proprietary software over open source options?

options.A: To share modified versions of the program with competitors
options.B: To freely rewrite the internal programming code themselves
options.C: To avoid paying any licensing fees for installation
options.D: To gain access to official vendor support and standard features

explanation: Proprietary software is typically backed by commercial vendors who provide reliable updates, technical support, and established user interfaces. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T3#BMP123_U1_T3_h5)
